name: 品牌（资产/评估/审计）体系

map.输入品牌财务和市场指标，按Interbrand模型评估品牌资产价值: Enter brand financial and market metrics to assess brand equity value with the Interbrand model
map.本工具基于 Interbrand 品牌评估思路：以品牌年净利润 × 品牌贡献率得: This tool follows the Interbrand brand valuation approach: annual brand net profit × brand contribution rate gives brand net profit, the brand strength factor is then used to derive an adjusted discount rate, and the brand net profit over the forecast horizon is discounted and summed to obtain the present value of brand equity. It runs entirely in the browser, so input data never leaves it. Results are for management reference and investor communication only; formal financial disclosure must comply with accounting standards and be audited.
map.品牌收购或授权谈判时，给品牌单独估一个可报价的数。: Value a brand separately when negotiating an acquisition or a licensing deal.
map.融资路演或年报披露，以一致标准量化并披露无形资产价值。: Quantify and disclose intangible asset value on a consistent basis for funding roadshows or annual reports.
map.集团内部审计考核品牌部门对利润的真实贡献。: Audit internally how much the brand function really contributes to group profit.
map.一笔品牌资产现值估算: One brand equity present value estimate
map.品牌年净利润 1000 万元、品牌贡献率 30% → 品牌净利润 300 万元；: Annual brand net profit 10 million CNY at a 30% brand contribution rate gives brand net profit of 3 million CNY; brand strength factor 0.8 (strength score 80); discount rate 10% over a 5-year horizon: discounting 3 million a year and summing gives a brand equity present value of about 11.37 million CNY.
map.强度系数对估值的影响: How the strength factor moves the valuation
map.同样 300 万品牌净利润，强度系数从 0.6 提到 0.9，折现率通常下降、现: With the same 3 million CNY of brand net profit, raising the strength factor from 0.6 to 0.9 usually lowers the discount rate and lifts present value by about 15%-25%, showing that a stronger brand moat earns a higher valuation premium.
map.品牌贡献率怎么定？: How is the brand contribution rate set?
map.用剔除品牌因素前后的利润差除以总利润，或按行业基准（快消约 25%–40%）校准: Divide the profit difference before and after removing brand factors by total profit, or calibrate against an industry benchmark (about 25%-40% for fast-moving consumer goods); combine this with the company's own history and comparable firms.
map.品牌强度系数代表什么？: What does the brand strength factor represent?
map.0–1 之间，反映品牌忠诚度、市场地位与抗风险能力，系数越高折现率越低、估值越高: On a 0-1 scale it reflects brand loyalty, market position and resilience. A higher factor means a lower discount rate and a higher valuation; score the ten Interbrand dimensions and normalize the result.
map.Interbrand模型通过品牌净利润折现计算品牌资产价值: Interbrand Model discounts brand net profit to obtain brand equity value
map.品牌强度7维度：领导力、稳定力、市场力、国际化、趋势力、支持力、保护力: Seven brand strength dimensions: leadership, stability, market, internationalization, trend, support and protection
map.品牌贡献率反映品牌对购买决策的影响程度: The brand contribution rate reflects how much the brand influences purchase decisions
map.折现率应考虑无风险利率和品牌风险溢价: The discount rate should allow for the risk-free rate and a brand risk premium
map.品牌审计应定期进行，建议每2-3年评估一次: Brand audits should be repeated regularly, every 2-3 years is recommended
map.品牌资产评估工具，基于Interbrand模型计算品牌净利润现值，评估品牌强度等: Brand equity assessment tool: based on the Interbrand model it discounts brand net profit to present value and grades brand strength and asset value.
